label: release-current-31

environment.policy: execution-v1; isolated Python; scrub application overrides; isolated Git

provider_mode: injected deterministic fake; no live model calls
completion_boundary: persisted passing review; no documentation, Git delivery or push
measurement_scope: fresh repository; fixture initialization through passing review
limitations: One deliberately repair-requiring fixture; not autonomous coding quality or general task success.
First-pass acceptance is expected false by fixture design, not a model accuracy score.
Event-projected active/waiting time is not CPU time; concurrent task times are not summed.
Fake provider reports no usage/cost; null fields remain unavailable, not zero or estimated.
Interpreter startup/Git fixture setup/reload checks are excluded from execution_elapsed_ms.
Smoke timings are unqualified; capture mode requires an externally coordinated quiet environment.

execution_elapsed.p95_method: nearest-rank; small-sample maximum is not a tail-latency estimate

child_process_elapsed.p95_method: nearest-rank; small-sample maximum is not a tail-latency estimate
